The '''''Stalwart''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] that [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vocis Kenit]] used in his search for the ''[[Far Orbit]]''.
